question: Who is the author of the book, 'Men in White - A Book of Cricket'?
solution: The correct answer is **__Mukul Kesavan.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Mukul Kesavan** is an** Indian historian, novelist and political and social essayist**. • **Men in White- A book of Cricket by him was published in 2007**.
